faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Booking your cleaning is super easy! Just hop on our website, pick your service, choose a date and time, and you're all set.

items.question: How do I book a cleaning?
items.answer: Booking online is a breeze and takes only a few minutes. Simply choose your desired service, select a convenient date and time, and confirm your booking instantly with just a few clicks.

items.question: Are your cleaners trained and background-checked?
items.answer: Yes — every cleaner goes through a thorough background check and training program before being assigned to any client's home.

items.question: What cleaning supplies do you use?
items.answer: We use eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning products that are safe for children, pets, and the environment, without compromising on results.

items.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the cleaning?
items.answer: Your satisfaction is our priority. If you're not happy with the results, contact us within 24 hours and we'll send a team back to re-clean at no extra charge.
